name: 10709-eagerdecode-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, bf16 -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (same weights, and the `base_model_name_or_path` the served adapter declares). The Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA with 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, bf16, ~16.1 GB of weights, plus one LoRA adapter `algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora` (r=64, lora_alpha=16).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 600 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. `ignore_eos` is on, so every stream generates its full sampled length and the decode batch sits near 32.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42, no prefix buckets. Prompts 512 +- 128 tokens, generations 256 +- 32 tokens. Radix cache is off, so nothing is reused between requests and every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A fact-generation assistant on an 8B model with a LoRA adapter, serving 32 concurrent half-page prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit 1c3dbad8fee4bf1631924cc03165d60819a7a473.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented continuation line is skipped when this file is read,
# so a structured value must stay on one line or the key is silently dropped.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# Requests select the adapter by the non-OpenAI `lora_path` body field, set in scenario.json.
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
lora-backend: csgmv

disable-radix-cache: true
disable-cuda-graph: true
